title: Swarm task
description: One unit of work submitted to POST /v1/tasks or `python -m swarm --task`.

id.description: Stable task identifier; generated when omitted.

objective.description: What the swarm must produce. Normalised to single spaces.

inputs.description: Free-form scalar inputs available to the workflow.

max_steps.description: Lower bound applied on top of the workflow and global budgets.

allowed_tools.description: Further restricts the tools any persona may call for this task.
